issue.title: test: improve coverage of Run-with-no-arguments paths
issue.body:
Follow-up to #2401 (index out of range panic fix). The fix introduced `TestRunWithNoOsArgs` and a `no arguments at all` case in `Test_checkShellCompleteFlag`, but two combinations remain unexercised:

1. **Empty args + `EnableShellCompletion` + empty `Name`** — the only path where both new guards fire together (`setupDefaults` empty-name guard plus the shell-completion `buildCompletionCommand("")` append). Confirmed manually not to panic, but untested.
2. **`TestRunWithNoOsArgs` does not assert `cmd.Name == ""`** after `Run` for the unnamed case — asserting it would lock in the documented behavior (root command keeps an empty Name rather than panicking).

Low priority: pure coverage/robustness hardening; no behavior change.
